messages:
jordan: Heads-up: rolling out SDK modularization v1.0.0 + docs site redesign this week. Breaking change: the default retry policy is now 'idempotent-only' — non-idempotent calls (e.g., write ops) will NOT auto-retry by default. We will ship a compatibility shim for 90 days. Migration checklist + sample apps: https://go/redwood/sdk-modularization (internal). Release window: Wed 2026-03-25 08:00 PT. Ping @kevin for customer comms.

release-bot: Published release candidate redwood-sdk v1.0.0-rc1 to staging. Changelog: https://go/redwood/releases/sdk-modularization-rc1

maya: I'll land the migration guide and new package docs today. Will add a short 'pin legacy behavior' how-to and a migration checklist. ETA EOD Mon.

jordan: Quick pin example (temporary):

jordan: ```bash
# pin legacy retry behavior for now
export REDWOOD_SDK_LEGACY_RETRY=true
pip install redwood-sdk-compat==0.9
```

jordan: or in python:

jordan: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(legacy_retry=True)
```

sam: Do we have a shortlist of customers to auto-notify? I can draft the email template and sample upsell messaging for compat support.

kevin: Sales/AMs already looped. We'll proactively notify customers >$50k ARR and any Dedicated/Private accounts. Also can we add a Console banner on release day?

maya: Yes — adding a changelog banner and redirects from the old samples page. Samples repo will be split into samples/core and samples/adapters; I'll add README redirects and update the sample-app manifests.

jordan: If anyone spots regressions post-rollout, escalate to #release-war-room. We'll hold an emergency roll-back window for 24h.

release-bot: Deployment scheduled for 2026-03-25 08:00 PT. Staging tests passing: 132/135. :rocket:

kevin: :thumbsup: Thanks all — please double-check docs and samples today.
